name: Rampart 20x Playground
initializeCommand: cd .devcontainer && touch .codespace-secret-key tap-codespace.env && chmod 666 .codespace-secret-key tap-codespace.env && { [ -s .env ] || printf 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=%s\nTAP_SEARCH_READONLY_PASSWORD=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 24)" "$(openssl rand -hex 24)" > .env; }
postStartCommand: until [ "$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H 'Host: localhost' http://127.0.0.1:8000/healthz)" != 000 ]; do sleep 5; done; set -a; . /run/tap-codespace.env; set +a; uv run python manage.py boot
